supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the visible outer corner of the eye.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle region exhibits significantly lighter pixel intensity compared to the dark-pigmented cheek and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderately thick lower lip with visible structural droop and a central nodular protrusion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A light-colored, prominent nodular protrusion or lesion is visible on the center of the lower lip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of sparse, light-colored (white/grey) hair on the chin area.
